_comment: Review-loop config. Everything here is tunable. See README.md.

coderabbit._comment: Runs the CodeRabbit CLI and parses its --agent NDJSON output.

agent._comment: The swappable coding-agent adapter. Contract: reads the prompt on STDIN, edits files in place, prints a ```json summary block on stdout. PERMISSIONS: '--permission-mode acceptEdits' auto-approves file edits, and '--allowedTools Read,Edit,Write' limits it to those tools so it never blocks on a prompt and can't run shell/git. For zero checks use '--permission-mode bypassPermissions'. Swap this whole array to move off Claude Code.

gate._comment: Layered static gate. py_compile = syntax; ruff E9,F63,F7,F82 = the 'flake8 critical' set (syntax + undefined names). No GUI, no execution.

selection._comment: The 'day's work' cap. A FILE is the unit — all of a file's suggestions go to ONE session together. max_changed_files=1 means one file (one claude session) per run, so you control token spend by re-running when you have headroom. The extension does not tag severities, so rank_by defaults to 'paste_order': you set priority by pasting important files first. Set rank_by='severity' to float files whose text mentions critical/potential issue/etc.; severity_order applies only in that mode.
